name: Last (K)night
source:
Sometimes Shin believes he's dead inside. Until he meets a strange woman chased by the mafia. She casts a magic spell on him to save herself, making him a target too, and cursed to die after 24 hours to boot.
Now that being a dead man has gone from a mere feeling to a promise, Shin will have to decide what to do with what remains of his life, discovering in the process that death may always have been a part of him.
translation:
有时候，辛觉得自己的内心已经死了。直到他遇见一位被黑手党追赶的神秘女子。为了自救，她对他施了魔法，不仅让他也成为追杀目标，还使他受到诅咒，将在24小时后死去。
如今，“死去”不再只是一种感觉，而成了注定会到来的结局。辛必须决定如何度过所剩的人生，并在这个过程中发现：死亡或许一直都是他的一部分。
